summary: Agent show, list and client-v0 reads report terminally retired agents as retired

replay.detail: Reads use the admitted agent.retired lifecycle claims already used by first-send admission; no replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema or generated contract changes. The existing agent state already supports retired.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or registry digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Agent cards now derive terminal retirement from lifecycle records, including optimized list and exact reads, instead of relying on a retirement marker in a selected declaration. Stopped agents remain distinct. Existing history filtering and operational annotations are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action or client regeneration required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
